notes.code_only: Hand-checked extractions (tests/fixtures/extractions), an approve-everything VP and an accept-everything critic, so every status comes from code: grounding, validation, the guardrail and the ledger. fresh: each file on a freshly seeded DB. shared: data/invoices in sorted order on one DB (null for the fixtures/invoices files), where 1011.txt and 1012.txt are DUPLICATEs of their PDF twins and 1004_revised is ESCALATED because 1004 was paid a different amount.
notes.replay: main.py --json over data/invoices (replay_shared) and fixtures/invoices (replay_fixtures), each folder on one fresh DB, served from fixtures/llm_cache (recorded with grok-4.3). Every extraction passes its grounding check on the first attempt, and every failure code matches code_only. Every file with a failed check is REJECTED with each code cited; 1003's wire-transfer pressure, 1005's White House address and 2002's prompt injection are also listed as concerns. Escalations are soft signals the VP cited: 1004 and 1004_revised (742 Evergreen Terrace is a TV-show address; on the revision the VP first calls payment_history(INV-1004)), 1012 pdf/txt (vendor rename 'formerly FastShip Ltd.') and 1014 (EUR). The VP approves 1001, 1006, 1010 (its +20% rush line listed as a concern), 1011 pdf/txt, 1015 and 2001 ($12,500, over the scrutiny threshold), and the critic accepts all 7; 1011.txt is then a DUPLICATE of its paid PDF twin.
